channel.title: Fence Building Tips & Calculators | YardCompute
channel.description: Plan a wood fence: posts, rails, pickets, panels, gates and concrete.

item.title: How Many Fence Panels Do I Need? Panels and Posts by Fence Length
item.description: See how many 8 ft fence panels and posts you need for a 50 to 300 ft fence, with 10% extra panels to order. Use the free fence panel calculator for your exact fence length and panel width.

item.title: How Many Fence Posts Do I Need? Fence Post Chart
item.description: Quick fence post chart for 50 to 300 ft fences at 6 ft and 8 ft spacing. Learn the simple formula (posts = sections + 1), how to space posts evenly, and when to add posts for corners and gates.

item.title: How Many Pickets for a Fence Gate? Gate Width Chart
item.description: How many 5.5 inch pickets does a wood fence gate need? This chart covers gates from 3 ft to 12 ft wide with a 1/8 inch gap, and the free gate calculator works it out for your own picket size.
